subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The teacher printed the promise and put it on the wall.”?
options: When problems happened, she pointed to it and asked, "Which promise can help us now"
Sharing designs can help more people solve problems, but it also requires testing, safety checks, and responsible use.
Instead of only counting the bottles, he asked everyone to read the words on them.
Finally, the music teacher asked each group to explain why their song fit the class.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The teacher printed the promise and put it on the wall. When problems happened, she pointed to it and asked, 'Which promise…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sharing designs can help more people solve problems, but it also requires testing, safety checks, and responsible use.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Instead of only counting the bottles, he asked everyone to read the words on them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Finally, the music teacher asked each group to explain why their song fit the class.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The teacher printed the promise and put it on the wall. When problems happened, she pointed to it and asked, 'Which promise can help…」，答案為「When problems happened, she pointed to it and asked, 'Which promise can help us now'」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When problems happened, she pointed to it and asked, 'Which promise can help us now'」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
